scope: The original 1910 Finnish Labour Temple at 314 Bay Street, with its entrance stairs, columned porch, polygonal center tower, intact cupola and original hall mass.

references.artist: Uncredited photographer, Thunder Bay Finnish Canadian Historical Society collection

originalReview.notes: The catalog dates this early intact exterior to 1910. The photo records the complete lantern, spire, two end bays, porch gallery and frontage stairs.

references.artist: Uncredited photographer, Thunder Bay Finnish Canadian Historical Society collection

originalReview.notes: The newspaper-era front shows the window rhythm, pale lintels, chamfered bay hoods, balustrades, porch columns and double entrance in higher detail.

quallaSearch.notes: Checked the published Qualla photographs first. The early hero has an attribution license, and the two nominally public-domain strike pictures document a later alteration phase. Used two source archive public-domain prints from the original newspaper-in-basement appearance.
